experiment: T=2 held-out confirmation under the frozen final protocol, 20260922
seed_pairing: none: q=50 and q=60 use disjoint seed lists, so the 20 runs are 20 distinct seeds. The two q are different games, so cross-q pooling stays descriptive, not inferential.
changes_vs_20260915: protocol.weights_every: new, 25 (non-behavioural: weight export is read-only and consumes no RNG)
seeds 10001-10020 (shared by both q) -> 10101-10110 at q=50 and 10111-10120 at q=60, disjoint; group and output_dir renamed
formal_candidate_rule: First valid C development call with BR and concentration passing, including the cap call; no-candidate final iterate evaluations are diagnostic only.

runs.action_sampling: numpy float64 Beta; clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6]; store float32; old/new log-prob on stored action
